levels.surface: عبد الرحمن بن محمد بن سلام

notes: «قالا حدثنا إسحاق الأزرق» joins the two compilers' teachers into one level (co-transmitters), then one route to Anas.
Anas, asked by عبد العزيز بن رفيع, answers and relays the Prophet's practice: he is the last link (rule 5, rule 6). Same narrative as the Abu Dawud report of this scene, read from its own text.
